calls.title: Harper Concierge + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting discussed the integration of checkout data into GrowthBook to facilitate easy experiment analysis. Logan explained the connection of Athena as a data source, emphasizing the importance of mapping user identifiers for comprehensive data linkage. The setup of custom SQL fact tables was outlined, indicating that they would include timestamped metrics and can be adjusted retroactively. Martin highlighted the e-commerce checkout funnel metrics use case, which will track crucial data points like SKU and checkout times. Additionally, GrowthBook's automatic calculation of statistical significance was presented, along with features for safe experiment rollouts. The open-source nature of GrowthBook allows for customization, while API connectivity supports integration with existing tools. The team expressed confidence in using the platform, reinforced by ongoing support through Slack.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Metrics, Experimentation, Data Integration, Funnel Analysis, Statistical Significance
